ticket.summary: 15-year-old garbage disposal seized/dead; customer wants like-for-like replacement, we supply 1/2 HP unit. Sink otherwise drains fine, no leak.
mitigation_advice: Leave disposal switch off and unplug/breaker-off the unit until the tech arrives
Do not use chemical drain cleaners in that sink basin
Clear the under-sink cabinet before the appointment
Sink can be used normally since it still drains

quote_lines.description: 1/2 HP continuous-feed garbage disposal, standard grade (supplied)
Labor: remove seized disposal, install replacement, test drain/connections

ticket.customer_message: You're all set, Yuki! Booked for tomorrow, Tue Sep 1, 8-10am - we'll supply and install a new 1/2 HP continuous-feed disposal. Total $325 ($140 unit + $185 labor), about an hour on site. Until then: leave the disposal switch off (and unplug it or flip its breaker if easy), don't pour any drain chemicals down that side, and if you could clear out the under-sink cabinet before we arrive, that speeds things up. You can keep using the sink normally since it drains fine.
